解答 由对称性，只考虑 $L$ 位于第一象限部分 $L_1$，则

$$
I=4\int_{L_1}\left(x^{\frac{4}{3}}+y^{\frac{4}{3}}\right)ds=4a^{\frac{4}{3}}\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\cos^4 t+\sin^4 t\right)\sqrt{x_t'^2+y_t'^2}\,dt
$$

$$
=4a^{\frac{4}{3}}\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\cos^4 t+\sin^4 t\right)\sqrt{9a^2\cos^4 t\sin^2 t+9a^2\cos^2 t\sin^4 t}\,dt
$$

$$
=12a^{\frac{7}{3}}\left[\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\cos^4 t+\sin^4 t\right)\sin t\cos t\right]dt
$$

$$
=12a^{\frac{7}{3}}\left[\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin t\cos^5 t\,dt+\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^5 t\cos t\,dt\right]=4a^{\frac{7}{3}}
$$
